category_scope: Beauty & Personal Care (hair care, skin care, oral care); general rules where noted
how_brands_deliver_content: First-party supplier model. Dis-Chem's group site runs a "Supplier Information Portal" page asking prospective suppliers to email the marketing team with company and product details for evaluation by its buyers. No self-service listing tool, content template or content-partner route is published; listing content for dischem.co.za is presumably agreed with the buying/e-commerce team after acceptance (not confirmed). The customer site dischem.co.za refused automated access on 2026-11-26.

languages.note: Not stated as a rule; the supplier page is in English.

rules.requirement: Prospective suppliers submit an enquiry by email with company name and description, contact details, product name and function, proposal, similar products on the market and any other relevant files.

official_quality_signals.notes: No official content or listing-quality score is documented in the public pages that could be retrieved.

limitations: Only the supplier-enquiry route is public. No content specification, regulatory data requirement or quality score for Dis-Chem listings was found. Web search was unavailable when this retailer was researched (shared search budget exhausted), so discovery relied on directly reachable official and content-partner pages.
